name: Hubb.Church
shortDescription: UK all-in-one church platform for websites, apps, administration, communications and giving.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a connected website, app and administration platform
Teams wanting to publish events, communications and media from a shared system
Churches evaluating people, giving, rotas and resource-booking tools alongside a site

pricing.summary: The current public product pages available to this review did not provide a dependable, complete price list. Request a current written quote covering subscription, website templates, app publishing, payment charges, onboarding and any optional modules.

tiers.label: Hubb.Church platform
tiers.detail: Public material describes connected website, app and church-management tools

gdprInformation: Public product information accessible to this review did not provide the current supplier privacy and data-processing documents. Because the platform can hold people, giving and communication data, obtain the current data-processing agreement, hosting details, permissions and exit process before adoption.
support: Published supplier support telephone and email

uk-operator.value: Hubb Digital Limited is an active UK company; it was previously named Endis Limited, the entity identified in a public Hubb.Church service-terms notice.

hmrc-claiming.value: HMRC's current commercial-supplier list identifies Hubb.Digital and its Hubb.Church website and management system.

church-scope.value: Public church-facing material describes website, app, people, rotas, giving, rooms, newsletters and sermons within Hubb.

editorial.assessment: Hubb.Church is a long-established UK all-in-one option that brings a church website, app and administration features into one platform. It may appeal to churches that want shared publishing and operations rather than separate website and database suppliers. Its publicly crawlable product information is currently incomplete, so the purchase conversation should establish current features, price, data terms and exports in writing.
bestFor: Churches wanting an integrated website, app and church-administration system
Teams coordinating events, news, rotas, people and media from one platform
Churches that value a UK supplier and are prepared to test the combined workflow carefully
strengths: Active UK operator with a long trading history
HMRC currently lists the supplier's website and management system
Church-focused material describes broad coverage across public and administrative workflows
limitations: A full current public pricing and data-processing pack was not available in the product pages reviewed
Combined website and administration products need robust ownership, permission and content workflows
Confirm current imports, exports, payment costs, accessibility and exit arrangements before migration

procurementVerdict.problem: Separate website, app, communications and administration tools creating duplicate work
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK church-specific platform designed to combine public content with administration
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request current product and data documentation, then trial an event-to-website-to-app-to-rota workflow using real permissions
